guard.discriminator: classify(): 'verifier' iff basename starts with 'V' OR the doc carries 'verdict' OR the doc carries 'overall'; otherwise 'unit'. Verifier is judged against VERIFIER_CONTRACT (unit, overall, checks, blocker, next_unit_hint, write_paths); unit against CONTRACT (unit, status, artifacts, evidence, blocker, next_unit_hint, write_paths).
guard.ambiguous_file_behaviour: Fail-loud, not silent: a unit report that carries 'overall' is classified verifier and then reported as a NEW gap on the missing 'checks' -> the suite FAILS. A V*-named file that is really a unit report is likewise judged as a verdict and fails on missing 'overall'/'checks'. Measured: no unit-named handoff currently carries overall/verdict ([]), so there is no live false failure. Residual hole: an ambiguous file that IS listed in the frozen baseline would absorb the misclassification silently.
guard.new_missing_key_failure_verbatim: fixture U9.99.json (valid JSON, unit-shaped, missing blocker/next_unit_hint/write_paths, not in any baseline): audit gaps {'U9.99.json': ['blocker','next_unit_hint','write_paths']} -> _regressions NEW = {'U9.99.json': [...]} -> would FAIL. Live, on the real tree: AssertionError: NEW unit-shape handoff contract gaps: {} {} ; NEW verifier-shape gaps: {} {'V6E.json': ['next_unit_hint']}  (tests/test_orchestration_handoffs.py:164, 1 failed 7 passed)
guard.unparseable_failure_verbatim: recorded pre-repair bytes of U0.22 were on disk (state/logs/U8.15/repairs/U0.22.before.json) and were used: [{'file': 'U0.22.json', 'error': "JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter: line 6 column 32 (char 1165)"}], mid_write [] - exactly the defect U8.15 recorded.
guard.can_hide_a_real_regression: no for a NEW handoff or a NEW key (proved: baselined V5F.json losing 'checks' yields worsened {'V5F.json': ['checks']} -> FAIL); yes for the loss of a key ALREADY listed in that file's baseline (invisible by construction) and yes for an over-declared baseline. The defect here is the mirror image - an UNDER-declared baseline - which produces a permanent, false RED rather than a hidden regression.
